evidence_scope: Consolidation of previously obtained official source/docs only. No new browsing or source reads for this delivery.
dedup_scope: Previously read baseline229 plus all four github-expansion-20261025 group catalogs (accepted117), total346 tools/70Skills. Semantic research notes are not parent acceptance or an exhaustive proof of distinctness.
delivery_scope: Research inventory only; no adapters, schemas, Skills, registration, installation, tests, release or deployment.
common_unverified_risks: Every proposed ID and scientific scope requires parent cross-group dedup review before implementation.
Exact source releases are recorded; these are not complete install locks. Missing transitive/native pins are null, not inferred.
No CPU tests or independent numeric-oracle fixtures were authored or executed in this delivery.
Future interfaces must be bounded and closed, preserve CRS/units/masks/provenance, and prohibit arbitrary callables, commands, pipelines and network data access.
No installed package or shared environment is to be replaced or downgraded on the basis of this inventory.

PDAL.license: BSD-3-Clause; bundled components have separate notices

operations.scientific_task: Coarsen a supplied D8 drainage network with iterative hydrography upscaling, retaining coarse drainage connectivity.
operations.distinctness_note: Changes network resolution; existing accumulation, flow-direction and Strahler operations do not perform hydrography upscaling.
unverified_risks: Fixed method='ihu'; validate acyclic D8 input, terminal semantics, masks and affine scaling. NumPy/Numba compatibility and numerical behavior were not executed.

operations.scientific_task: Compute unit-catchment floodplain storage volumes in m3 for supplied water depths and HAND elevations in m.
operations.distinctness_note: Uses existing HAND as input to stage-storage integration; not another HAND or depression-fill operation.
unverified_risks: Require explicit outlet indices, cell areas, vertical datum and HAND validity. Upstream missing-outlet sentinel must not become a valid volume. No hydraulic inundation forecast is implied.

operations.scientific_task: Simplify shared parcel boundaries while preserving a valid polygon coverage.
operations.distinctness_note: Retains individual simplified parcels; existing coverage union dissolves their internal boundaries.
unverified_risks: GEOS >=3.12 gate; parent previously reported GEOS 3.13.1. Invalid or overlapping coverage must be rejected. Tolerance is approximately square-root removed triangle area, not a maximum displacement guarantee.

operations.scientific_task: Redistribute extensive environmental totals between polygon partitions using overlap-area weights.
operations.distinctness_note: Polygon-to-polygon redistribution of totals differs from polygon intersection and raster zonal statistics.
unverified_risks: Equal-area/projected CRS and explicit overlap/coverage policy required. allocate_total and fill_nan must be explicit; no silent redistribution of uncovered totals or missing observations. Additional GeoPandas/rasterstats dependencies are not locked.

operations.scientific_task: Summarize groundwater transfers and budget residuals between supplied model zones from an existing cell-budget file.
operations.distinctness_note: Interzonal flux accounting differs from existing uppermost water-table extraction.
unverified_risks: ZoneBudget construction performs budget processing before get_budget. Require bounded local budget files, matched integer zones, time selection and declared volumetric-rate units. Do not invoke MODFLOW or ZoneBudget6 executables.

operations.scientific_task: Convert groundwater model face fluxes into the complete Darcy discharge vector using cell geometry and saturated thickness.
operations.distinctness_note: Produces physical flow vectors from face budgets, not water-table extraction or a confined-well head solution.
unverified_risks: Declare length/time units and face versus center positions. Preserve dry/inactive masks and north/up signs; Darcy flux is not pore-water velocity. Model-object setup remains unvalidated.

operations.scientific_task: Locate image pixels through supplied rational polynomial sensor coefficients and explicit ellipsoidal heights.
operations.distinctness_note: Sensor-model geolocation differs from reprojecting an already affine-georeferenced raster.
unverified_risks: Input heights are WGS84 ellipsoidal metres; outputs are longitude/latitude degrees. Pixel-center offsets, inverse convergence and failed-point warnings need CPU acceptance. Forbid arbitrary RPC options, DEM paths and network access; native GDAL build is not locked.

operations.scientific_task: Geolocate legacy map or image pixels from surveyed ground-control points using a thin-plate-spline transform.
operations.distinctness_note: Fits a georeferencing transform from controls rather than applying an existing CRS-to-CRS warp.
unverified_risks: Fixed tps=True; require nondegenerate controls, explicit control-point CRS, pixel conventions and interpolation extent. No silent extrapolation or CRS assignment. Native GDAL version and residual acceptance remain unresolved.

operations.scientific_task: Measure local spatial variation in residual dispersion with LOSH.
operations.distinctness_note: LOSH measures spatial variance heterogeneity, not the mean association or squared-neighbour contrasts returned by existing Moran and Geary tools.
unverified_risks: Require aligned numeric observations and explicit spatial weights, no islands and nonzero residual variance. Fixed exponent a=2; descriptive statistic only until inference is separately approved.

operations.scientific_task: Partition neighbouring environmental zones into attribute-similar contiguous regions using SKATER.
operations.distinctness_note: Creates graph-contiguous regional partitions; remote image segmentation and existing Voronoi service regions solve different tasks.
unverified_risks: Explicit connectivity, feature units/scales, minimum region size and island handling required. The method is heuristic, not a global optimum guarantee. GeoPandas/networkx and other transitive dependencies remain unlocked.

operations.scientific_task: Count environmental events close in both space and time, and report the independence expectation.
operations.distinctness_note: Space-time event interaction is distinct from spatial-only Moran/Geary association and spacetime semivariograms.
unverified_risks: Use projected distance and explicitly declared time units. Fix permutations=0 for deterministic initial scope; do not label counts as causal evidence. Pair counting and threshold inclusivity need acceptance.

operations.scientific_task: Choose a fixed number of environmental service or monitoring facilities minimizing demand-weighted assignment cost.
operations.distinctness_note: Optimizes which sites to open; existing cost allocation only assigns cells to sites already selected.
unverified_risks: Cost units, nonnegative demand weights and feasibility must be explicit. PuLP >=3.2,<4 is declared upstream, but exact solver/package/binary pins are unresolved. Only a parent-approved fixed CPU solver is acceptable.

operations.scientific_task: Find the minimum number of facilities that covers every demand location within a declared service threshold.
operations.distinctness_note: Minimizes facility count subject to full coverage, unlike p-median's fixed-count total-cost objective or allocation to existing sites.
unverified_risks: Require finite cost matrix, explicit threshold units and infeasibility reporting. Exact PuLP/CPU solver lock is unresolved; no user-selected executable or solver options.

operations.scientific_task: Advance terrain elevations through a physical linear hillslope sediment-diffusion timestep.
operations.distinctness_note: Evolves terrain through sediment transport rather than smoothing an image or extracting static slope.
unverified_risks: Declare elevation/spacing in m, diffusivity in m2/s, time in s and boundary conditions. Fixed simple method; retain deposition and mass-balance semantics. Full Landlab compiled dependencies including py-richdem remain unvalidated.

operations.scientific_task: Advance channel elevations with the implicit Fastscape stream-power incision algorithm.
operations.distinctness_note: Models fluvial bed incision, not existing flow-direction, accumulation or Strahler calculations.
unverified_risks: Supply valid receivers, upstream order, drainage areas and positive link lengths. Erodibility units depend on area exponent; timestep, threshold and flooded-node policy must be explicit. Full compiled dependency stack is unvalidated.

operations.scientific_task: Integrate an area-normalized channel distance coordinate for longitudinal-profile analysis.
operations.distinctness_note: Area-normalized longitudinal coordinate differs from existing physical distance-to-outlet and stream order.
unverified_risks: Require single-receiver acyclic routing, m2 drainage/reference areas and m link lengths. Fix use_true_dx=True; preserve hillslope mask separately from valid zero chi at outlets. Landlab dependency acceptance is pending.

operations.scientific_task: Classify LiDAR ground returns with the Simple Morphological Filter.
operations.license: BSD-3-Clause; bundled components have separate notices
operations.distinctness_note: Ground/non-ground classification of 3D returns differs from 2D raster morphology or remote image segmentation.
unverified_risks: Native C++ stage filters.smrf, not a Python callable. Fix the stage; no caller-supplied pipeline. Require metric XYZ, explicit return/classification handling and morphology parameters. Native PDAL build and full dependency lock are unresolved.

operations.scientific_task: Normalize LiDAR return heights against nearby ground-classified returns.
operations.license: BSD-3-Clause; bundled components have separate notices
operations.distinctness_note: Height above a local ground surface is not raster height above a downstream drainage cell and is not generic nearest-neighbour reporting.
unverified_risks: Native fixed stage filters.hag_nn. Require ground class 2, sufficient neighbours, metric XYZ and an explicit interpolation support policy. Upstream can leave/produce zero for missing ground or unsupported interpolation; such cases must be distinguished from valid zero HAG. No native lock or CPU acceptance yet.

operations.scientific_task: Align two 3D surveys with iterative closest-point rigid registration.
operations.license: BSD-3-Clause; bundled components have separate notices
operations.distinctness_note: Rigid 3D rotation/translation of irregular point clouds differs from existing 2D raster phase-correlation translation.
unverified_risks: Native fixed stage filters.icp; requires overlapping, sufficiently close initial poses and nondegenerate metric XYZ. Global optimum is not guaranteed. Use composed world-coordinate transform; upstream fitness is mean Euclidean distance, not the MSE its comments suggest. Native dependency lock remains unresolved.

operations.scientific_task: Compute terrain line-of-sight visibility from a specified observer location.
operations.distinctness_note: Visibility depends on intervening terrain obstruction, unlike proximity, access paths or catchment delineation.
unverified_risks: Only the literal module r.viewshed is proposed, not generic command dispatch. Require isolated mapset, explicit computational region/CRS/NULL mask, observer and target heights, curvature/refraction policy and bounded distance. Native GRASS build is not installed or locked by this research.

operations.scientific_task: Describe point-pattern concentration across distance scales with uncorrected Ripley K using the observed bounding-box window.
operations.distinctness_note: Pairwise point-pattern concentration across scales differs from point-count rasters and attribute-based local spatial statistics.
unverified_risks: This callable does not accept an arbitrary survey-window argument and edge correction is unimplemented. Require explicit acceptance of the observed bounding box, nonzero area and projected units. Do not claim an edge-corrected estimate or significance.

operations.scientific_task: Evaluate supplied environmental region boundaries by comparing within-region and adjacent-region attribute dissimilarity.
operations.distinctness_note: Evaluates an existing regional partition; it neither creates clusters nor measures Moran/Geary association.
unverified_risks: Require aligned contiguous numeric IDs, libpysal weights without islands, explicit feature scaling and a fixed metric. Upstream changes NumPy error settings and has fragile alternate-Graph handling; worker isolation/error-state restoration needs design and acceptance.

operations.scientific_task: Advance a shallow unconfined aquifer under Dupuit flow, recharge and surface-discharge coupling.
operations.distinctness_note: A spatial unconfined aquifer timestep differs from existing homogeneous confined-well analytic solutions and head extraction.
unverified_risks: Require m elevations, m/s conductivity/recharge, porosity, time in s and explicit boundaries. Distinguish m2/s discharge per width from m/s velocity. Reject out-of-domain initial heads rather than silently clipping; regularization, stability and compiled dependencies are unvalidated.

operations.scientific_task: Advance two-dimensional shallow overland flow and rainfall on a terrain grid with the de Almeida local-inertial method.
operations.distinctness_note: Spatial overland flow on a 2D terrain differs from the existing one-reach kinematic-wave step and lumped runoff models.
unverified_risks: Require metric grid, water depth in m, rainfall in m/s, SI roughness and time in s. Explicit closed/open boundaries, wetting threshold and timestep policy are essential. Upstream steep-slope depth correction can alter water mass; compiled dependencies and conservation acceptance are pending.

operations.scientific_task: Construct faces from noded survey linework and return dangling, cut and invalid-ring diagnostics.
operations.distinctness_note: Builds and diagnoses polygons from line networks, not classified raster cells or an existing parcel split.
unverified_risks: Require explicit CRS, finite coordinates and pre-noded linework. Do not silently snap, node or repair; preserve all four result categories. Numerical/topological acceptance has not run.

operations.scientific_task: Compute layer contributions to saturated transmissivity over specified well-screen intervals.
operations.distinctness_note: Screen-limited hydraulic capacity differs from water-table extraction, borehole resampling and well drawdown solutions.
unverified_risks: Require consistent model length/time units, hydraulic conductivity, layer boundaries, heads and ordered screen intervals. Output has length2/time units. Explicitly handle dry/inactive layers and partially penetrating screens; model-object construction remains unvalidated.

operations.scientific_task: Measure ordered channel-planform or survey-line separation with discrete Frechet distance.
operations.distinctness_note: Compares complete ordered curves, unlike nearest-site distance, geodesic transects or raster change metrics.
unverified_risks: Use projected coordinates with declared length units and explicit vertex sampling/densification. Preserve line direction; reversal can change the result. No silent resampling, correspondence or uncertainty claim.

operations.scientific_task: Estimate planar event/site density with a Gaussian kernel and explicit metric bandwidth.
operations.distinctness_note: Continuous bandwidth-based density differs from the existing Datashader cell-count grid.
unverified_risks: Fit the fixed Gaussian/Euclidean model first. Log density output must be identified or explicitly exponentiated to m-2. Bandwidth, survey window and lack of boundary correction must be disclosed; finite bounded coordinates only.

operations.scientific_task: Identify density-connected event/site clusters and isolated noise using spatial DBSCAN.
operations.distinctness_note: Clusters an irregular site point pattern with noise rejection, not raster superpixels, watershed regions or nearest-neighbour matches.
unverified_risks: Fixed Euclidean metric with metric CRS, bounded point count, explicit eps/min_samples and deterministic input order. Labels are arbitrary IDs; border assignments and duplicate observations need an explicit policy. Dense neighbourhoods can require quadratic memory.

operations.scientific_task: Compute direct, diffuse and reflected surface solar radiation with terrain shadowing and explicit atmospheric conditions.
operations.distinctness_note: Surface radiation with atmospheric attenuation and terrain shadows differs from existing TopoFlow top-of-atmosphere horizontal flux.
unverified_risks: Only literal module r.sun is proposed. Requires isolated mapset and fixed CPU limits, explicit region/masks, slope/aspect conventions, turbidity/albedo and solar versus civil time. Instantaneous W/m2 and daily Wh/m2/day must never be conflated. Native GRASS dependency lock and numerical acceptance remain unresolved.
